steps.name: apply-night-observability-and-fix-pyserial-shadow
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller agent-control
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "d05a3abb8cf375a116f93082343b01f1a0f26709"
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/20260902-stage27c-night-observability-v2.py.zlib.b64 | python3 -c 'import base64,sys,zlib; exec(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(sys.stdin.buffer.read())))'
python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('tools/stage27c_soak.py'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('import argparse
', 'import argparse
import importlib
', 1); s=s.replace('import serial
from serial.tools import list_ports
', 'if __package__ in {None, ""}:
    sys.path[0] = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])

serial = importlib.import_module("serial")
list_ports = importlib.import_module("serial.tools.list_ports")
', 1); p.write_text(s)"
.venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.h src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.cpp || true
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh src/CMakeLists.txt src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.h src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.cpp tools/stage27c_soak.py tests/test_stage27c_soak.py
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: focused-night-observability
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "d05a3abb8cf375a116f93082343b01f1a0f26709"
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_stage27c_soak.py -q
.venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --help >/dev/null
.venv/bin/python -m tools.stage27c_soak --help >/dev/null
bash -n scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -q 'soak_v=2 firmware_sha=' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
grep -q 'ble_scan_restarts=' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
grep -q 'rtc_read_errors=' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
grep -q 'outputs=fake-locked' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-software-gate-and-publish
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "d05a3abb8cf375a116f93082343b01f1a0f26709"
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_stage27c_soak.py -q
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure
git diff --check
git add scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh src/CMakeLists.txt src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.h src/climate/native/BleClimateScanner.cpp src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.h src/climate/native/Ds3231ClockSource.cpp tools/stage27c_soak.py tests/test_stage27c_soak.py
git commit -m 'Add Stage27C overnight soak observability'
git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
test -z "$(git status --short)"
git rev-parse HEAD
